purpose: independent synthetic-model breadth diagnostic for the exact v12 candidates

gate.fake_family_boundary: 78 named latent-diffusion variants, not 78 independent architectures
gate.initial_check_defect: the first quick comparison omitted v12 source_image_sha256 identities

evaluation.conditions: clean plus the 19 individually applied workshop transformations
evaluation.codec_contract: each condition is followed by label-independent JPEG q96 normalization

interpretation: A pass is evidence of transfer to a v12-identity-disjoint latent-diffusion-heavy source. A failure is a breadth alarm. Four fakes per named model make per-model values high variance; the mixed real side includes sources not eligible for submission training. The class counts are unequal after overlap removal, which does not change ROC AUC but does change threshold-based summaries, so no threshold metric is used.
decision_boundary: This previously opened external source remains audit-only. It may not train, calibrate, tune blend weights or support a hidden-score claim. The v12 comparison is diagnostic and no extra blend weights may be tried.
